author: Worth Sparkman
title: Gov. Sanders covers topics from Trump to motherhood - NewsBreak
text:
By Worth Sparkman ,
17 hours ago Screenshot: Courtesy of Fox News Gov. Sarah Huckabee Sanders appeared on " The Riley Gaines Show " podcast Tuesday for a wide-ranging conversation covering President Trump, state economics, education and motherhood. What she said:
On Trump: "One of the reasons that the president is so popular and was able to win the presidency, and the reason he's been able to get things done, is because he is not a scripted robot, and he is very raw."
On tax cuts: "As conservative Republicans, we believe that people can spend their money more wisely than the government can. So let's let them keep more of it."
On kids' health: "We heard a statistic the other day that our prisoners now spend more time outside than our kids do," she said.
"Our kids are only spending about seven minutes a day outside and seven hours a day on a screen," she said, a statistic from "The Anxious Generation" by Jonathan Haidt. On motherhood: "I learned a long time ago I was never going to win on the quantity side … I had to win on the quality side," she said of not making it to every school event for each of her three children.
"I have to be really intentional about the time that I have with my kids … I think that I'm a better governor because I'm a mom."
